verdict.rationale: The evidence gives only indirect control over data. Khoj can be self-hosted on your own hardware so data never leaves your device, which effectively puts retention in the user's hands (khoj-docs-3, khoj-docs-38). Telemetry can also be switched off with an environment variable (khoj-docs-21). Missing for 10: any documented controls for deleting chats, indexed files or accounts, configurable retention periods for Khoj Cloud, and independent or hands-on confirmation that deletion works.
